why: A is the six fibre/push lemmas for Gr(X) at universe 0 (Tφ on fibres, grPush_mem/comp/unit). B says the project's Gr x, GrObj and grProj are the text's. For Gr(x), B uses GrB: ℚ-weights of any sign on sets L ⊆ T_xX that are finite-dimensional linear subspaces in some chart. The project's Gr x is a documented choice (gap G.7, no linear structure on Part I's T_xX): nonnegative weights on arbitrary subsets of vectors over x. So B's three Gr-membership conjuncts do not hold as we read them. not_B uses the trivial ep-groupoid of ℝ⁰: the sum 1·∅ lies in Gr x but not in GrB x, because a chart image of ∅ is empty and a submodule contains 0. Hence A ⇒ B is false (not_A_to_B), and B ⇒ A holds only ex falso. B_rest_holds proves outright the four conjuncts of B that do not mention GrB: objects are determined by (pt, sum); morphisms o ⟶ o' are exactly the φ with s φ = o.pt, t φ = o'.pt, o'.sum = φ_* o.sum (pushB = grPush); π is faithful on morphisms; π(x, a) = x. nonneg_mem_GrB_to_mem_Gr shows GrB ∩ {weights ≥ 0} ⊆ Gr. So the only difference is the generators and the sign convention of Gr(x). The project allows more generators; Theorem 9.2.1's values are chart subspaces anyway (exists_submodule_of_mem_support).
